headline: 5 contract addresses catalogued on Ethereum (3 Morpho vaults, 1 owner multisig, 1 curator multisig); no GitHub or audit links found; on-chain reads not performed this run.

findings.text: D1: Block-explorer name-tag search not attempted via direct fetch (fetch quota exhausted); addresses discovered via official docs instead. Etherscan links for multisig addresses appear in docs and are recorded in evidence.

D2: Official docs at armitage.wintermute.com/docs list deployment details for three live vaults: Wintermute USDC Prime (0x5dc53a23AdC9f2Bed98de6F59F7F309a7c71FF2B), Wintermute USDC Select (0xA2EAaD0D586cF9FD73bb2c09cF6A7E3e187D68cd), and Pendle Ecosystem USDC (0x55C1B6e461a6334B567bAF0FEb5D728715446f05). All three share the same Owner (Safe 4/6: 0xb83a77677c51aaf6c45b0b64199eae6938559e5e) and Curator (Safe 3/5: 0x4687e45bb5518a995913a24bb2816fe2031d74d8). Apex vault is planned but not yet deployed.

D3: No audit links were provided in the per-protocol context, and no audit PDFs or reports were surfaced from the website or docs. The risks page mentions due diligence processes but cites no external audit firms or reports.

D4: No GitHub repository was provided in the per-protocol context and none surfaced from the website or docs. Armitage curates existing Morpho Vault V2 infrastructure rather than deploying its own smart contracts, so absence of a protocol-owned GitHub repo is architecturally expected.
D5: Protocol is Ethereum-only per pinned context and docs. No multi-chain enumeration required. Docs note Apex (planned) and future chains are in scope but undeployed.

D6: No factory addresses discovered. Armitage vaults are curated Morpho Vault V2 instances, not products of a proprietary factory. Market allocations (cbBTC/USDC, wstETH/USDC, WBTC/USDC for Prime; 7 markets for Select; 4 Pendle PT markets for Ecosystem) are referenced via Morpho UI links but are Morpho Blue market IDs, not Armitage-controlled factory children.

D7: Role taxonomy applied: vault contracts tagged as 'vault'; owner multisig tagged as 'owner' (actor_class: multisig, threshold 4/6); curator multisig tagged as 'other' with role 'curator' (actor_class: multisig, threshold 3/5). Allocator and Sentinel roles exist per Morpho Vault V2 RBAC but addresses were not surfaced in docs this run.

D8: All five addresses in admin_addresses[] trace directly to fetched docs pages (armitage.wintermute.com/docs/vaults/prime, /docs/vaults/ecosystem, /docs/llms-full.txt). No addresses sourced from snippets only.

rationale.verdict: Discovery run walked the official website, all vault-specific docs pages, and the full LLM documentation export. Five addresses were catalogued: three Morpho Vault V2 vault contracts and two Safe multisigs (owner and curator) shared across all vaults. No GitHub repo, no audit PDFs, and no block-explorer name-tag data were reachable this run. On-chain reads were not performed due to fetch quota exhaustion; those are recorded in unknowns[].

protocol_metadata.about: Armitage is Wintermute's onchain vault curation arm, launched in May 2026, that curates Morpho Vault V2 lending vaults on Ethereum. Depositors supply USDC into one of three vaults (Prime, Select, or Pendle Ecosystem USDC), and Armitage allocates that capital across Morpho Blue lending markets using institutional risk management and Wintermute's trading infrastructure. Unlike most curators, Armitage executes liquidations internally across every supported market, enabling it to accept a broader range of collateral types. Vaults are non-custodial and permissionless; depositors can withdraw at any time subject to market liquidity.
